name: Mordovia (Mordovian SSR, 1990–1995)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Мордовская ССР' in Russian, Moksha and Erzya in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Mordovian ASSR with the three-language inscription changed after the sovereignty declaration of December 1990. It was replaced on 30 March 1995 by the red, white and blue flag with the Mordvin sun.

features.role: inscription 'Мордовская ССР' in Russian, Moksha and Erzya
